# OpenJam — Complete Documentation for AI Models

> OpenJam is a free, open-source, real-time collaborative music listening platform where friends can create virtual rooms, queue songs, and experience perfectly synchronized audio playback together.

## What is OpenJam?
OpenJam allows users to create virtual "jam rooms" where multiple listeners can join and hear the same music at the exact same moment. It uses NTP-style clock offset calculation over WebSocket connections to achieve millisecond-accurate synchronization across all connected clients.

## How does real-time music synchronization work?
OpenJam measures network round-trip time between each client and the server using WebSocket ping/pong messages. It calculates a clock offset for each listener, then continuously adjusts playback positions so all listeners in a room hear the exact same audio beat at the same millisecond. The sync engine runs every 5 seconds with sub-100ms correction thresholds.

## Features

### Listening Rooms
- Create public or private rooms with custom names and descriptions
- Join any public room as an anonymous guest or authenticated user
- Real-time listener count and presence indicators
- Room host controls: skip, seek, pause, and queue management
- Auto-play: rooms automatically play the next queued track

### Music Queue
- Search and add tracks from YouTube
- Collaborative queue with democratic skip voting
- Queue reordering and track removal by room host
- Import tracks from saved playlists

### Social Features
- Live room chat with message history
- Floating emoji reactions visible to all listeners
- User profiles with avatars, banners, bios, and custom themes
- Follow other users and discover their playlists

### Playlists
- Create, name, and organize personal playlists
- Share playlists via direct link
- Import entire playlists into a room queue
- Album art fetched automatically from YouTube thumbnails

### Stage View & Lyrics
- Full-screen Stage View with animated album art
- Kinetic karaoke-style synchronized lyrics display
- Ambient background effects based on album art colors

### Progressive Web App
- Install on iOS, Android, Windows, macOS, and Linux
- Offline music library for downloaded tracks
- Background audio playback support

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Is OpenJam free?
Yes, OpenJam is completely free with no subscription fees, ads, or paywalls.

### Do I need an account to listen?
No. You can join any public room as an anonymous guest. Creating an account unlocks profile customization, playlists, and listening history.

### How many people can join a room?
There is no strict limit. Dozens of listeners can join simultaneously.

### What music sources are supported?
OpenJam currently supports YouTube as its music source, with plans to expand.

### Can I use OpenJam on mobile?
Yes. OpenJam has a fully responsive mobile interface and can be installed as a PWA.
